item.title: US signs nearly $1 billion deal with France's TotalEnergies to end offshore wind projects
item.summary: The United States and TotalEnergies signed an agreement on Monday to end the French company's offshore US wind farm projects and redirect those funds towards fossil fuel production, with the US interior secretary saying the deal was worth nearly $1 billion.
